display.purpose: Screen headings and hero numerals only. Condensed — takes a size step more than Archivo, wants neutral-to-positive tracking.

title.purpose: Section headings; tuned for the condensed face (1.375rem / 1.12 / +0.012em).

body.purpose: Everything spoken at UI size — labels, body, buttons, data at 13–16px. `.tabular` on numerals.

label.purpose: Terse uppercase data labels beside values only. Never a kicker above a heading.

shadows.name: elev-card
shadows.purpose: Default card depth: 1px machined top-light plus two true downward drops.

shadows.name: elev-ember
shadows.purpose: Heat under a raised piece — a TRUE offset warm shadow for the one hero action per screen. Replaced the banned zero-offset copper halo.

shadows.name: dock-shade
shadows.purpose: Upward shade separating the docked CTA from the scroll region behind it.

motion.name: spring-press
motion.purpose: Taps, toggles, chips — direct physical response; paired with scale 0.97 (0.985 for cards).

motion.name: spring-sheet
motion.purpose: Bottom sheets in; exit is a faster 160ms ease-in tween.

motion.name: ff-keyframes
motion.purpose: Celebration kit (ff-spark, ff-ripple, ff-pop, ff-pop-fade, ff-shimmer, ff-halo, ff-rise-in, ff-tab-spark, ff-ember-breathe, ff-shake) — compositor-only overlays.

components.name: Primary Button (knurled hero CTA)
components.description: Copper fill, near-black ink; the knurl grip band marks the one full-width primary CTA per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--accent, #c98963); color: var(--accent-foreground, #1c0f08); font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; border-radius: inherit; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 4px, rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 4px 5px); -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 22%, #000 38%, #000 62%, transparent 78%); mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 22%, #000 38%, #000 62%, transparent 78%); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #d99b76); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--accent-press, #b0714c); transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c98963); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet surface-2 button with a hairline border that strengthens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--surface-2, #1d1815); color: var(--foreground, #f3ede5); font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2c2520); border-radius: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #4a4036); background: var(--elevated, #282019); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 0.8; transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c98963); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip (selected)
components.description: Capsule toggle; selection is marked by a check that springs in from zero width.
components.css: .ds-chip { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; margin: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; background: var(--surface-2, #1d1815); color: var(--foreground, #f3ede5); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2c2520); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #4a4036); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c98963); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip--selected { border-color: var(--accent, #c98963); background: var(--accent-muted, #2b1d14); color: var(--accent, #c98963); } .ds-chip-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }

components.name: Card (standard)
components.description: Surface-2 fill, hairline border, 24px radius, machined top-light shadow.
components.html:
Bench Press

4 sets × 6–8 reps · 72.5 kg
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface-2, #1d1815); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2c2520); border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.055), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 12px 28px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.95); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--foreground, #f3ede5); } .ds-card-desc { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #a89e93); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Premium Card (forged)
components.description: Gold gradient hairline border — reserved for the plan preview, PR cards, and the Today hero.
components.css: .ds-card-premium { border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; background: linear-gradient(var(--surface-2, #1d1815), var(--surface-2, #1d1815)) padding-box, linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(201,137,99,0.55), rgba(201,137,99,0.08) 70%) border-box; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.055), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 12px 28px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.95); } .ds-hero-num { margin: 0; font-family: 'Big Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--foreground, #f3ede5); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-hero-sub { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #a89e93); }

components.name: Steel Card (machined anchor)
components.description: Top-lit vertical gradient + 1px inner highlight; rationed to the two structural anchor surfaces.
components.html:
Push Day A

6 exercises · ~52 min
components.css: .ds-card-steel { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--elevated, #282019) 0%, var(--surface-2, #1d1815) 22%); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2c2520); border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.055), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 12px 28px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.95); } .ds-steel-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Big Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: 0.012em; color: var(--foreground, #f3ede5); } .ds-steel-desc { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #a89e93); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Heat Bar (signature progress)
components.description: The progress grammar: copper stock heating toward the goal, ember at the leading edge. Bars, never rings.
components.html: Protein142 / 180 g 79%
components.css: .ds-heat-wrap { width: 100%; min-width: 240px; } .ds-heat-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-heat-label { font-weight: 500; color: var(--foreground, #f3ede5); } .ds-heat-val { color: var(--muted-foreground, #a89e93); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-heat-val b { margin-left: 6px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--foreground, #f3ede5); } .ds-heat-track { height: 8px; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--muted, #231d18); } .ds-heat-fill { height: 100%; width: 100%; transform-origin: left; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-press, #b0714c), var(--accent, #c98963) 62%, var(--energy, #e2703a) 97%); transition: transform 300ms ease-out; }

components.name: Barbell Progress Bar
components.description: Collar caps on each end so training progress filling up reads as a barbell loading.
components.css: .ds-bar-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; min-width: 240px; padding: 6px; } .ds-bar-collar { pointer-events: none; position: absolute; top: 50%; height: 14px; width: 8px; transform: translateY(-50%); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--border-strong, #4a4036); } .ds-bar-collar--l { left: 0; } .ds-bar-collar--r { right: 0; } .ds-bar-track { height: 6px; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--muted, #231d18); } .ds-bar-fill { height: 100%; width: 100%; transform-origin: left; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent, #c98963); transition: transform 300ms ease-out; }

narrative.overview: FitForge's world is the forge itself: warm iron surfaces (charcoal with heat under it, never blue-black), machined edges, and copper as the single voice of emphasis. Dark is the brand default; the light Ivory theme is opt-in only and never auto-switched. Depth is machined, not glowing: a 1px inset top-light where a milled edge would catch light, plus true offset shadows that fall down as light demands. Progress is heated stock — copper filling toward the goal with ember at the leading edge — rendered as bars, never rings. The direction contract ships inside the artifact (layout.tsx embeds it as a production HTML comment) and is the world's charter; the owner pins dark + copper and the untouched anvil logo.
keyCharacteristics: Warm iron neutrals — every gray carries a whisker of heat; blue-black is the named anti-reference.
One accent (copper), one heat state (ember), one progress grammar (the heat bar).
Machined depth: inset top-lights and true offset shadows; zero-offset halos are banned.
Two faces with a hard division of labor: Big Shoulders condensed for headings and hero numerals, Archivo for everything else.
Drawn 1.75-stroke icons on a 24 grid — food included; emoji are not an icon system here.
Phone-first: 390×664 target viewport, bounded 3-zone screen shell, ≥44px touch targets.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Copper is the only accent. A second identity hue anywhere — including per-macro colors — breaks the world. Macros are told apart by label and value, not by hue.

rules.name: The Heat-State Rule
rules.body: Ember (--energy) appears strictly as heat-state: the leading edge of real progress and the honest over-target signal. Never as ambience, backgrounds at rest, or emphasis.

rules.name: The Warm Iron Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries warmth. Blue-tinted neutrals (#0b121a–#3e4a58, the retired palette) are the named anti-reference — 'the most saturated AI-dashboard look there is.'

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders = headings + hero numerals ONLY. Archivo = everything else — labels, body, buttons, data. A Big Shoulders label or body line is a defect.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No kicker/eyebrow labels above headings. Uppercase micro-labels exist solely as terse data labels beside values. Emphasis is weight, size, or solid copper — never gradient text.

rules.name: The Density Mechanism
rules.body: .ff-dense on a screen container re-scales the whole Tailwind type ramp to ~93% via the --text-* custom properties. TYPE ONLY — spacing is untouched so every 44px target stays 44px.

rules.name: The One Anchor Rule
rules.body: One full card per screen region earns a card; secondary content rides hairline ledger rows, not more cards.

rules.name: The Heading Is the Date Rule
rules.body: Screen headings state facts (the full weekday, the date), never greetings.

rules.name: The Machined Edge Rule
rules.body: Depth = 1px inset top-light + true offset shadows falling down. Zero-offset halos ('glow') are banned from the token file — decoration is not depth.

dos: Do keep dark + copper as the brand: dark :root is default, light Ivory only via explicit data-theme="light"; the anvil logo is pinned untouched.
Do put .tabular on every data numeral and keep touch targets ≥44px (md button = h-11; .ff-dense scales type only, never spacing).
Do render continuous progress as heat bars (.ff-heat), with solid ember only when over target; keep discrete pips and rings solid.
Do ration the signature treatments: one glow hero action per screen, knurl only on the one full-width primary CTA, steel only on structural anchors, premium only on the few forged cards.
Do draw every icon on the 24-grid / 1.75-stroke / round-caps / currentColor grammar, food included.
Do give every tappable element an :active answer (.ff-press/.ff-press-soft or Motion whileTap), and the house focus ring (outline-accent, 2px, offset 2).
Do compose screens as one anchor card + hairline ledger rows; build app screens on the .screen / .scroll-region / .cta-dock shell with svh units and --dock-clearance.
donts: Don't use gradient text — emphasis is weight, size, or solid copper (.text-gradient-gold was deleted; do not recreate it).
Don't use zero-offset glows/halos — depth is the 1px inset top-light plus true offset shadows falling down.
Don't use emoji as icons, kicker/eyebrow labels above headings, or uppercase micro-labels for anything but terse data labels.
Don't introduce a second accent: ember is heat-state only, green is a true success state only — never macro or identity hues.
Don't set Big Shoulders on labels or body copy, or negative-track it anywhere.
Don't bring back rings for progress (MacroRing is retired from product surfaces), blue-tinted neutrals, or the Inter/Space Grotesk pairing.
Don't use dvh for animated heights, off-family radii (the family is 12/16/24 + pill), or Tailwind layered utilities against the unlayered shell primitives (.cta-dock + empty:hidden, etc.).
Don't cap desktop single-column layouts wider than 720px unless a real second column exists.
